def trialSigma (n : Nat) : Nat := ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, if n % d = 0 then d else 0

def isAmicable (a b : Nat) : Prop := sigmaN a = sigmaN b ∧ sigmaN a = a + b

def Acount (x : Nat) : Nat :=

    (Finset.product (Finset.Icc 1 x) (Finset.Icc 1 x))).card
